profile.headline: Web Developer | UI/UX Design | Front-End Technologies | API Development
profile.summary: I’m a Front-End Developer with 12+ years of experience building scalable, user‑focused web applications with React and TypeScript. Certified in Front-End Development (Meta) and UX Design (Google), I merge clean design with technical precision to create accessible, high‑performing digital experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front End
positions.description:
I work on front-end development for agent-facing Card Tech applications, building internal tools using Vue.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript that support servicing and operational workflows.

I collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver scalable, accessible, and maintainable interfaces used by internal agents across high-impact financial systems. My work focuses on shared UI patterns, front-end architecture, and engineering best practices that improve reliability, consistency, and developer efficiency.

Technologies: Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, WCAG, Agile

projects.title: VibeKit — Theme Design Toolkit
projects.description:
A browser-based theme-design toolkit. Users craft a full design system — 10 semantic colors, dual-font typography with a modular type scale, border radius, and a brand logo — then export to CSS variables, Tailwind config, W3C Design Tokens JSON, or SCSS in one click. Every theme gets a public shareable preview page.

Highlights:
- Multi-format exports: CSS, Tailwind, Design Tokens JSON, SCSS
- Live preview with themed web dashboard + mobile app mockups that update as you edit
- WCAG contrast validation across 12 meaningful color pairings from the user's own palette
- Palette generator with monochromatic, analogous, complementary, and triadic schemes; auto-derives sensible neutrals and status colors
- Modular type scale — set a base size and ratio (Minor 2nd through Perfect 5th) to derive h1-h6 mathematically
- Saved themes with relative-time labels, type-to-confirm delete, public preview URLs

Tech stack:
Frontend — React 18, TypeScript, Vite, custom design system in SCSS, Ant Design for the color picker
Backend — Cloudflare Workers, D1 (SQLite at the edge), R2 (logo storage)
Tooling — Wrangler, Google Fonts API, The Color API

Built solo with AI pair-programming. UX research, journey mapping, and prototyping in collaboration with Krystina Bradley. Originated from Girls Develop It's "Fearless UX: Unleash Your Creative Potential" workshop, applying the "vibe-coding" methodology learned from Piyush Acharya at Git Merge 2025.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description:
My personal website serves as a comprehensive professional portfolio, showcasing my expertise as a frontend developer alongside my background as a classical musician. It presents a curated selection of projects, technical skills, certifications, and experiences with modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, and UI/UX design principles.

The website also highlights my involvement in subscription-based models and reflects my multidisciplinary interests, including music, archery, and roller derby. Designed with a clean and accessible interface, it offers an insightful overview of my capabilities and professional journey.

I welcome you to explore my work and connect for potential collaborations or opportunities.
Tech Stack: GitHub, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Photoshop, Illustrator

Repository: https://github.com/ajkendal/ajkendal.github.io
